title: model : fix qwen4exp layer inputs for DFlash drafters
body:
## Overview

`qwen4exp` exposes its hyper-connection residual `[n_embd, hc, n_tokens]` as `t_layer_inp`, but drafters read layer inputs as `[n_embd, n_tokens]` rows. Loading a DFlash draft over a `qwen4exp` target therefore aborts on the first request:

```
src/llama-context.cpp:2409: GGML_ASSERT(row_floats == model.hparams.n_embd) failed
```

Collapse the streams with a plain mean before exposing them, the same way `deepseek4` already does for its hyper-connection residual. The mean is only built for layers that a drafter actually requested (`cparams.embeddings_layer_inp`), so normal inference is unchanged.

## Additional information

Reproduced with the published draft of the same repo (asserts on the first request on current master):

```
llama-server -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF:IQ4_NL --spec-type draft-dflash --lazy-mode on --port 9943 -lv 4 --host 0.0.0.0
```

The draft declares `dflash.target_layers = [6, 16, 26, 36, 46]` and `fc.weight [12800, 2560]`, i.e. 5 rows of `n_embd = 2560` from the target, while `embd_layer_inp` is allocated as `n_embd * n_batch`.

With the fix, the same command serves requests and speculates as expected (256 tokens, `draft_n=319`, `draft_n_accepted=147`, `mean acc len 2.37`, `acc rate/pos = (0.654, 0.421, 0.299)`, 52 tok/s, IQ4_NL target with a Q4_0 draft). Collapsing with the per-layer gated mixer instead of the mean was clearly worse (46% against 26% accepted draft tokens, mean acc len 2.37 against 1.78), which matches the `deepseek4` convention. `--spec-type draft-mtp` and `--spec-type none` are unaffected.

## Requirements

- I have read and agree with the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- AI usage disclosure: YES
  - Harness: `pi:llama.cpp`
  - Hardware: `MacBook, M5 Max, 128GB`
  - Model: [ggml-org/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF](https://huggingface.co/ggml-org/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF)
  - Stats: ◷ 36.5m · ⚙ 16.5m · ↑ 219k · ↓ 48k · ≡ 219 · ⌨ 6
